result.justification: The research objectives are stated, but the connection to the methodology lacks sufficient detail about experimental design and data analysis procedures.

evidence.quote: Here, we investigate immune imprinting by comparing phage-display antibody libraries from WT-infected convalescents in early 2020 (WT-AbLib) and Omicron-infected convalescents in early 2023 (Omi-AbLib).
The construction and screening of the phage antibody library followed previously established methods.
